messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By which date must Member States notify the Commission of the rules on penalties and the implementing measures provided for in Article 50 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: Entro quale data gli Stati membri devono notificare alla Commissione le norme sulle sanzioni e le misure di attuazione previste dall'articolo 50 del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230?
